annotations.title: Get one number and its connection status

description:
Check one number: its phone number, status, and when that status began.

`id` (`num_…`) is the number's permanent identifier. The alias can be
renamed, the `id` cannot. Either one works as `number_alias`.

`connected` means it can send right now. `connecting` means a connection
was just requested and is being set up; check again in a few seconds.
`reconnecting` means the number lost its connection and Turbo Notify is
bringing it back by itself: there is nothing to do but wait and check
again. Until it is `connected` again, sends are refused with
`number_not_connected`. `disconnected` means the link to the phone still
exists but the number is offline, so `connect_number` brings it back.
`revoked` means the phone unlinked the device, or another connection
took it over. `failed` means a pairing did not complete, and `reason`
says why (for example `pairing_timeout` when the code or QR code was
not used in time, `paired_phone_mismatch` when another WhatsApp used
it). Either one has to be paired again by a person holding that phone:
from the dashboard (main or extra number) or, for an extra number,
through the API's pairing endpoint, by code or by QR code. No tool here
pairs a number: it needs a person with the phone.

`pairing` means a person is pairing the number right now. The code or
QR code they use is not part of this answer: it belongs to that person.
Check again later; the status moves to `connected`, or to `failed` with
a `reason`.

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
